prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a vast stone courtyard of the Forbidden City with a standard-height palace gate, marble steps with waist-high balustrades, empty of visitors, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Egyptian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm golden-bronze skin, sharp winged kohl liner, a deep terracotta-red lip, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in a chin-length bob, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a tin hammer head, a gold cube-shaped block, a gold teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered gold rings. Extremely long coffin nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; everything about her is at its extreme at once: a towering frame with endless legs, a colossal heavy bust wider than her shoulders, a waist cinched to an impossible minimum, enormous round hips and a high rounded rear, gigantic thick thighs pressed together, smooth glowing skin over soft full curves; her silhouette is an exaggerated hourglass that dominates the whole frame from head to toe; not thin, not boyish, not evenly proportioned; her head looks small above her body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Klimt-inspired organic mosaic (an organic mosaic of small irregular tesserae with gold-leaf borders), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense organic curved mosaic filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme red plain stiletto pumps with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Argentinian person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a clean-cut young male model face with defined cheekbones, a firm jaw and strong straight brows, clean-shaven, sparkling glitter dusted under the eyes with rose-gold eyeshadow, smooth light-olive skin, a confident smirk, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in a high top-knot bun, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a gold small flared temple bell, a lead cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three platinum necklaces. Extremely long almond nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear; her head looks small on top of her massive body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Russian Palekh miniature lacquer (a deep black ground with fine gold linework and firebirds), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense jewel-toned scenework filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme black platform stiletto studded boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
